prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE original enemy bestiary illustration and production concept for an industrial fantasy action RPG. Subject M07 Cable Hauler: a very thin tall salvage creature built around an asymmetrical crane boom and a large exposed circular cable winding spool. This creature's signature is a slender angular CRANE ARM arcing upward and forward from its narrow torso, connected by visible steel cable to a heavy articulated three-prong grappling hook which hangs low near its small feet. The crane boom, taut cable and low hook form a strong clear open triangular negative space; the cable visibly comes from the large side-mounted winch disk and passes through boom pulleys. Two lanky reverse-jointed utility legs support the compact winch body, no thick armor, no muscular human anatomy, no humanoid head; instead a tiny sheltered amber pilot lamp peers from above the winding spool. Offset stance about to cast its hook, winding disk and interruptible tensioning assembly clearly exposed. Mechanical body lightly bound by mineral-organic tendons at joints, old mining hoist parts reconfigured into an original living machine. Preserve distinct slim crane-and-wheel silhouette rather than a fighting robot carrying a weapon. Premium richly hand-painted stylized industrial-fantasy design, refined deliberate engineering, rust and charcoal steel, scratched ochre enamel, copper cable coils and restrained warm vulnerable core, tactile layered materials with beautiful painterly light and readable shadows. Three-quarter entire body, all boom and hook fully visible with clear margins. Genuine transparent alpha background; no floor, ground, cast shadow, scene, platform, environment or haze. No text, logo, symbols, UI, watermark, decorative border or existing franchise likeness.
